meta.description: I design and build software for clients: native apps, web platforms and internal tools. Computer Engineering student at the University of Brescia.

hero.lead: I’m {name}. I design and build software for clients, from first sketch to production: native apps, web platforms and internal tools. I study Computer Engineering at the University of Brescia.

work.title: Work
work.lead: Four projects, from network protocol to interface.

approach.title: Built to connect
approach.body: The largest project I have built was called Ponte, Italian for bridge. It links phone and PC over the local network, a server, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct, and drops the duplicates. I work the same way. I keep interface, protocol and infrastructure together, so nothing gets lost between one step and the next.

stack.title: Tools
stack.lead: The technologies I have shipped to production in the projects above.

freelance.where: Websites, platforms and tools for clients

faq.title: Questions
faq.lead: The short answers live here. For anything else, write to me.

items.a: I design and build software for clients: native apps for Android and Windows, web platforms and internal tools, including integrations with AI models.
In Brescia, Italy. I work on site or remotely.

items.q: What projects do you take on?
items.a: Paid projects with a clear goal: a website, a platform, an app or an internal tool that needs to reach production.
It depends on the project. The ones I have already shipped are listed under Tools.
Tell me what you need, who it is for and by when. I reply with the questions still open and a proposal.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: For a project, a collaboration or technical advice.

story.title: Path
story.lead: From school to university, by way of a company and the first clients.

chapters.title: Two years in a company
chapters.body: Work placement at CS Metal Europe: 240 hours of work inside a company, spread over two years.

chapters.title: The final exam
chapters.body: To tell those two years I built a macOS-style desktop in PHP and MySQL, with a demo mode that shows the examiners the path of every request.

chapters.title: Computer Engineering
chapters.body: I start at the University of Brescia. I build my own study tools: StudyCut shortens recorded lectures and transcribes the formulas.

chapters.title: Software for clients
chapters.body: A platform for a tutoring centre, an app that links phone and PC across three platforms, and more client work.
